title: Haskoin Store
description: haskoin-store's metrics, read from InfluxDB as Telegraf's statsd input writes them, for a store that sends its own statistics (--statsd-aggregates --statsd-no-events). See docs/grafana.md of haskoin-store.

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_blocks" WITH KEY = "host"
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_blocks" WITH KEY = "host"

list.name: how
list.label: Percentile of
list.query: a typical second : mean("mean"),the worst second : max("upper")

panels.title: Block height
panels.description: Height of the best block that the store has imported (store.blocks).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_blocks" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Blocks behind
panels.description: Best header minus best block (store.headers - store.blocks). More than a few for long means that the store is not keeping up with the chain.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_headers" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_blocks" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Peers online (store.peers). At zero the store hears of no new blocks or transactions.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_peers" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests answered a second, every kind together: the counts of the web.* timings, added up. Exact: Telegraf adds the store's counts up.

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM /^${prefix}_stats_timers_web_(([^c]|c[^a]|ca[^p]|cap[^_])[a-z0-9_]*)_count$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Requests that failed with a server error, a second (web.server_errors).

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_web_server_errors_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Requests refused
panels.description: Requests refused with server-busy, a second, for any reason (web.requests_refused). See the Overload row for why.

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_web_requests_refused_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Requests by kind
panels.description: Requests answered a second, by kind of request (the count of each web.* timing). Exact: Telegraf adds the store's counts up.

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM /^${prefix}_stats_timers_web_(([^c]|c[^a]|ca[^p]|cap[^_])[a-z0-9_]*)_count$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Time spent answering, by kind
panels.description: Seconds spent answering each kind of request, for each second that passes: 1 is one core busy with it all the time. It says where the time of the store goes, which neither the rate nor the response time does alone. Exact: Telegraf adds the store's sums up.

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("sum")), 1s) / 1000 FROM /^${prefix}_stats_timers_web_(([^c]|c[^a]|ca[^p]|cap[^_])[a-z0-9_]*)_sum$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Response time by kind, percentile $pct
panels.description: The time within which $pct in a hundred requests of each kind were answered (web.* timings). The store works a percentile out for each second, and no percentile of a longer time can be made of those. Shown is the one chosen at the top: of a typical second (the mean of the seconds) or of the worst second. A second with fewer than ten requests of a kind has no 90th percentile to speak of: look at the longest then.

targets.query: SELECT ${how:raw} FROM /^${prefix}_stats_timers_web_(([^c]|c[^a]|ca[^p]|cap[^_])[a-z0-9_]*)_upper_$pct$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Longest response by kind
panels.description: The longest that a request of each kind took. Exact: the longest of the longest of each second.

targets.query: SELECT max("upper") FROM /^${prefix}_stats_timers_web_(([^c]|c[^a]|ca[^p]|cap[^_])[a-z0-9_]*)_upper$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Errors and reruns
panels.description: Requests that failed, a second: server errors (web.server_errors) and client errors (web.client_errors). Reruns (web.reruns) are requests answered again because a cached xpub that they read changed meanwhile.

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_web_server_errors_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_web_client_errors_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_web_reruns_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Event stream clients
panels.description: Clients connected to the stream of events (web.events_connected).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_events_connected" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests of the kind chosen at the top, a second. Exact: Telegraf adds the store's counts up.

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_web_${route}_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Response time
panels.description: Of the kind chosen at the top. The mean is exact: the sum of the times over the count of the requests, and not the mean that Telegraf makes of the means of the seconds, which counts a second with one request as much as one with a thousand. The percentiles are those of a typical second. The longest is exact.

targets.query: SELECT sum("sum") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_web_${route}_sum" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_web_${route}_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("mean") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_web_${route}_upper_90" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("mean") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_web_${route}_upper_95" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT max("upper") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_web_${route}_upper" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Seconds with requests
panels.description: Of each ten seconds, in how many the store answered a request of this kind. Below ten, the kind is quiet, and its percentiles are of few requests.

targets.query: SELECT mean("count") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_web_${route}_upper" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Overload: admission control of long requests
Long requests: limit, running and waiting
panels.description: The limit on long requests that the controller set (web.cap.limit), those being answered (web.requests_running) and those waiting for a slot (web.requests_waiting). A limit stuck at its ceiling with long waits points at the disk; one stuck at its floor with a high delay points at work that is not limited.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_cap_limit" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_requests_running" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_requests_waiting" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Requests refused, by reason
panels.description: Requests refused a second: because the line was full (web.cap.refused_full), after waiting too long (web.cap.refused_waited), or by CoDel (web.cap.refused_codel).

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_web_cap_refused_full_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_web_cap_refused_waited_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_web_cap_refused_codel_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Scheduler delay
panels.description: 90th percentile of the scheduler's delay in the last half second, without the garbage collector's pauses (web.cap.delay_us) and with them (web.cap.lateness_us). These are gauges: the last value of each ten seconds.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_cap_delay_us" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_cap_lateness_us" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Cores in use
panels.description: Use of the cores that the controller sees, smoothed over two seconds (web.cap.used, here in cores).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") / 100 FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_cap_used" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Wait for a slot, and time holding it
panels.description: How long an admitted long request waited for its slot (web.cap.sojourn: the 90th percentile of a typical second, and the longest), and the smoothed time that a long request holds its slot (web.cap.round_trip_us).

targets.query: SELECT mean("mean") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_web_cap_sojourn_upper_90" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT max("upper") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_web_cap_sojourn_upper" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT last("value") / 1000 FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_cap_round_trip_us" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Overloaded
panels.description: Whether CoDel finds the line of long requests overloaded (web.cap.overloaded).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_cap_overloaded" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Slots held, by long route
panels.description: Slots that each long route holds (web.cap.<route>.running).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM /^${prefix}_stats_gauges_web_cap_(.+)_running$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Wait for a slot by long route, percentile $pct
panels.description: The time that a request of each long route waited for its slot (web.cap.<route>.waited). The store works a percentile out for each second, and no percentile of a longer time can be made of those. Shown is the one chosen at the top: of a typical second (the mean of the seconds) or of the worst second. A second with fewer than ten requests of a kind has no 90th percentile to speak of: look at the longest then.

targets.query: SELECT ${how:raw} FROM /^${prefix}_stats_timers_web_cap_(.+)_waited_upper_$pct$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Slot held by long route, percentile $pct
panels.description: The time that a request of each long route held its slot, to the last byte (web.cap.<route>.held). The store works a percentile out for each second, and no percentile of a longer time can be made of those. Shown is the one chosen at the top: of a typical second (the mean of the seconds) or of the worst second. A second with fewer than ten requests of a kind has no 90th percentile to speak of: look at the longest then.

targets.query: SELECT ${how:raw} FROM /^${prefix}_stats_timers_web_cap_(.+)_held_upper_$pct$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Requests refused, by long route
panels.description: Requests of each long route refused a second (web.cap.<route>.refused).

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM /^${prefix}_stats_counters_web_cap_(.+)_refused_count$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Heights
panels.description: Height of the best block (store.blocks) and of the best header (store.headers).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_blocks" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_headers" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Import of the latest block, by stage
panels.description: Milliseconds that the latest block took to import, by stage: working out what the import needs (prepare), reading ahead what the rules will read (prefetch), the rules in memory (apply) and writing the batch to RocksDB (write). A slow prefetch is the disk or RocksDB's cache; the other stages are mostly CPU. (store.last_block_*_ms)

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_last_block_prepare_ms" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_last_block_prefetch_ms" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_last_block_apply_ms" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_last_block_write_ms" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Peers online (store.peers).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_store_peers" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Database reads by kind
panels.description: Reads of the database a second, by what was read (db.*).

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_best_block_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_blocks_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_txs_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_balances_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_unspents_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_address_txs_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_xpub_balances_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_xpub_unspents_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_xpub_txs_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_db_xpub_tx_count_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Open iterators
panels.description: Iterators open on RocksDB (db.iterators).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_db_iterators" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Pending compaction
panels.description: Bytes that RocksDB has to compact, over every column family (db.pending_compaction_bytes).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_db_pending_compaction_bytes" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Writes
panels.description: Writes to RocksDB: flowing, delayed or stopped (db.write_delayed). Delayed or stopped writes mean that compaction is not keeping up.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_db_write_delayed" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Transactions settled and messages dropped
panels.description: Transactions that peers named and that the pool decided on, or already had (ingest.settled), and messages of peers dropped because the path into the pool was behind (ingest.dropped), a second.

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_ingest_settled_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_ingest_dropped_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Transactions given up, by reason
panels.description: Transactions given up on their way to the pool, a second, by reason (ingest.given_up.*). Every reason but node_has_not makes the store read its sources again.

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM /^${prefix}_stats_counters_ingest_given_up_(.+)_count$/ WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Transactions on their way
panels.description: Transaction ids on their way to the pool (ingest.ids), those asked of peers and not received, which /health counts (ingest.pending), and those held (ingest.held).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_ingest_ids" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_ingest_pending" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_ingest_held" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Hits and misses
panels.description: Requests about an xpub whose balances the cache gave (fleet.cache.hits) and that the cache did not have (fleet.cache.misses), a second. Misses include xpubs being built.

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_fleet_cache_hits_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_fleet_cache_misses_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Share of hits
panels.description: Hits over hits and misses: how much of the load the cache takes. Exact: a ratio of two counts.

targets.query: SELECT sum("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_fleet_cache_hits_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_fleet_cache_misses_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Cache size
panels.description: Xpubs in the cache, whichever store cached them (fleet.cache.xpubs), and the addresses that they have between them (fleet.cache.addresses).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_fleet_cache_xpubs" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_fleet_cache_addresses" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Cache builds and evictions
panels.description: A second: entries that this store built or added addresses to (fleet.cache.builds), builds given up (fleet.cache.abandoned), entries evicted (fleet.cache.evictions) and times that this store emptied the cache (fleet.cache.emptied).

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_fleet_cache_builds_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_fleet_cache_abandoned_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_fleet_cache_evictions_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_fleet_cache_emptied_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Time to build an entry
panels.description: The time to build an entry (fleet.cache.build). The mean is exact: the sum of the times over the count of the builds. The longest is exact. Builds are few, so no percentile is shown.

targets.query: SELECT sum("sum") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_fleet_cache_build_sum" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_fleet_cache_build_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT max("upper") FROM "${prefix}_stats_timers_fleet_cache_build_upper" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Time stopped for the collector
panels.description: Share of each second that every thread was stopped (rts.gc_pause_percent). While stopped the store answers nothing, so a high share shows up as slow answers everywhere. A gauge: the last second of each ten.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_rts_gc_pause_percent" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Mean pause
panels.description: Mean pause of a collection in the last second (rts.gc_pause_mean_us).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_rts_gc_pause_mean_us" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)

panels.title: Collections
panels.description: Collections a second (rts.gcs), and those of the whole heap (rts.major_gcs).

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_rts_gcs_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_rts_major_gcs_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: CPU of the collector
panels.description: Cores that the collector uses (the rate of rts.gc_cpu_us).

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) / 1000000 FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_rts_gc_cpu_us_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Allocation
panels.description: Bytes allocated a second (rts.allocated_bytes).

targets.query: SELECT derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("value")), 1s) FROM "${prefix}_stats_counters_rts_allocated_bytes_count" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Heap
panels.description: Bytes live after the last collection (rts.live_bytes) and bytes that the heap holds from the system (rts.heap_bytes).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_rts_live_bytes" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "${prefix}_stats_gauges_rts_heap_bytes" WHERE "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "host" fill(none)
